bio: This restaurant enjoys a stunning location by the Vltava River in the heart of the city, right next to Charles Bridge. The chic and modern interior has floor-to-ceiling windows opening out onto a balcony terrace directly overlooking the bridge – you can also appreciate the view from some of the tables inside. In the open kitchen, the chefs create contemporary dishes, drawing on traditional Czech and international influences. Order à la carte, or opt for one of the set menus (The Most Popular, Tartare & Steak or Vegetarian). There is also a lunch deal, and brunch is available on Sat and Sun. Attentive service comes courtesy of a friendly and adept front-of-house team....
